exposure: weight loss among prepregnancy obesity classes
low gain considered below the 2009 Institute of Medicine guidelines
gestational weight gain categories of weight loss
cohort: 18,476 women among 3 classes of prepregnancy obesity, delivering a live singleton pregnancy at ≥37 weeks of gestation
finding: Lower gestational weight gain of +2.0 to 4.9 kg showed the most favorable perinatal outcomes, without higher small for gestational age or neonatal morbidity for all obesity classes.
